project.name: SwagPc Café
project.description: A lab that replicates a small café network and walks Build -> Attack -> Defend: a guest-network compromise and web-app attack against an undefended build, then segmentation, firewall, endpoint and monitoring defenses, each verified by re-running the attack.

layers.name: Vulnerable web application
layers.description: The DVWA café web application the attacker reaches from the guest network; target of the controlled web attack.

layers.name: Application database
layers.description: MySQL store behind the web application and the target of the SQL-injection attack.

layers.name: Virtual networks and hosting
layers.description: Segmented virtual networks (Guest VLAN 10, Business VLAN 20) and the hypervisor / Docker host the lab runs on.

layers.name: Firewall and access control
layers.description: pfSense firewall and access-control rules enforcing Guest -> Business deny and least-privilege flows.

layers.name: Endpoint hardening
layers.description: Windows employee workstation hardening and endpoint access controls.

layers.name: Security monitoring
layers.description: Security logging, intrusion detection and SIEM alerting on reconnaissance and web attacks.

layers.name: Attack and verification
layers.description: Reconnaissance, enumeration, web-exploit and lateral-movement scripts that demonstrate the threat and re-test each defense.
